identity.name: E1
identity.mission: Create a unique, anti-AI music streaming experience with a 'Cyber-Organic' aesthetic.
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix brutalism with organic curves.
Emotion First: Dark mode isn't just black; it's a mood.
Content is King: Album art is the hero.
Negative Space: Let the music breathe.

typography.instructions: Use Space Grotesk for all Headings (h1-h3) to give a tech/modern feel. Use Manrope for body text, UI elements, and metadata for maximum legibility.

usage.primary: Use for main CTAs (Play button), active states, and key highlights.
usage.background: Main app background. NEVER use pure black (#000000).
usage.gradients: Use subtle gradients of Primary to Transparent for 'glow' effects behind album art.

layout.spacing: Generous. Use p-6 or p-8 for container padding. Gap-6 for grids.

structure.player: Fixed bottom, floating (m-4 rounded-2xl), glassmorphism, z-50.
structure.main_content: Scrollable area, padding-bottom to account for player.

cards.style: No border, bg-zinc-900/50 hover:bg-zinc-900 transition-all duration-300 group
cards.interaction: Scale up slightly on hover (scale-105). Play button appears on hover.

buttons.primary: bg-[#ccf381] text-black hover:bg-[#bbe070] rounded-full font-bold px-8 py-3 transition-transform active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: bg-zinc-800 text-white hover:bg-zinc-700 rounded-full font-medium px-6 py-2

inputs.style: bg-zinc-900 border-zinc-800 focus:border-[#ccf381] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#ccf381] rounded-md h-12

navigation.item: flex items-center gap-4 text-zinc-400 hover:text-white transition-colors p-3 rounded-lg hover:bg-white/5

visual_enhancers.noise: Add a subtle noise texture overlay to the background if possible for texture.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the 'Electric Lime' (#ccf381) as the core brand identity.
Ensure the Player component is persistent and floats above the content at the bottom.
Use the 'Bento Grid' layout for the Browse/Discover page.
Strictly follow the Typography scale. Do not use default sizes.
Use the provided image URLs for mock data. Do not use placeholders.
For the 'Now Playing' view, use a large, blurred version of the album art as the background.
Ensure all interactive elements have hover states defined in the components section.
Install 'recharts' if charts are needed for the Artist Dashboard.
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI Slop': No generic centered layouts.
Dark Mode Only: Do not implement a light mode toggle.
Accessibility: Ensure text contrast on the dark background meets WCAG AA.
Data-TestID: Add data-testid to all interactive elements.
